title: Residential water filtration installs via FB ads + subcontracted plumbers
one_liner: Price-upfront Meta lead ads for under-sink/whole-home filtration; subcontract licensed plumbers for installs.
why_agent_runnable: Creative, landing, lead CRM, plumber sourcing drafts, and ad ops drafts are agent-native. Brandon owns ads spend, hire of plumbers, and customer money.

ops_steps.title: Geo water + competitor scan
ops_steps.detail: Public water quality notes, competitor pricing, and ad density for candidate ZIPs.

ops_steps.title: Brandon geo + offer pick
ops_steps.detail: Choose under-sink vs whole-home starter offer and price-upfront numbers.

ops_steps.title: Offer + landing + ad creatives
ops_steps.detail: Draft price-upfront Meta creatives, landing, FAQ, application form. Draft until publish gate.

ops_steps.title: Plumber bench shortlist
ops_steps.detail: Draft outreach to licensed plumbers for per-job install rates; Brandon hire gate.

ops_steps.title: Ads + payments go-live
ops_steps.detail: Approve Meta budget, business identity, Stripe deposits, and public copy.

ops_steps.title: Lead ops
ops_steps.detail: Score leads, schedule drafts, dispatch checklist; agent drafts SMS/email — Brandon send.

ops_steps.title: Install QA + review ask
ops_steps.detail: Post-install checklist; review request drafts; weekly unit economics sheet.

human_only_checkpoints: Any purchase, deposit, ad spend, or paid tool upgrade
Hiring contractors, VAs, or licensed trades
Publishing listings, sites, ads, social as official
Physical pickup, delivery, install, or on-site work

hiring_and_pay_flow.how_agent_initiates: Agent drafts Upwork/OnlineJobs/Craigslist job posts, contractor shortlists, SOWs, and payment memos in plan drafts only.
brandon_gates_before_money: approve recurring retainer or inventory buy

unit_economics_sketch.gross_margin_notes: Margin = job price − product COGS − plumber − ads − refunds. Price-upfront ads aim to qualify. Ranges are sketches only — not guarantees.
unit_economics_sketch.disclaimer: No income guarantees. Creator anecdotes ≠ your results.

first_7_day_agent_sprint: Day 4-5: landing + Meta creative drafts + plumber shortlist
Day 7: CRM live; ads ready (no spend until gate cleared)
kill_criteria: Cannot secure ≥2 licensed plumbers at workable rates in 14 days
Cost per booked install exceeds agreed ceiling for 14 days at test budget
Product warranty/returns erode margin on first 5 jobs
disclaimer: Research plan only. Not financial, legal, or investment advice. No income guarantees. Brandon approval required before money, hire, pay, publish, or send.
